decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'No automatic page-title/favicon fetching — titles come from you or are derived from the address. Flagged as a possible future enhancement.' Round 1 client: 'I want the app to automatically collect its real title, description, favicon, and preview image. I should still be able to edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker's baseline spec deferred all metadata auto-collection (contradicts REF-BM-02) and asked whether title fetching was wanted. Client rejected the deferral and supplied the reference-conforming behaviour (all four fields collected, title/description still editable per REF-BM-03). Corrective/correct — supplies conforming behaviour in place of the mismatch.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'duplicate-address warnings' (listed under 'Also included'). Round 1 client: 'If I save an address that already exists, take me to edit the existing bookmark instead of merely warning me.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented behaviour was warning-only on duplicate save, which diverges from REF-BM-06 (guide user to edit existing bookmark). Client negated the warning-only behaviour and supplied the conforming routing-to-edit behaviour; classified corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker offered a choice: 'Do you want tags in v1 (currently in), or defer them?' Round 1 client: 'Keep tags in v1.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker offered two alternatives differing in fulfilment of REF-BM-09/11 (keep vs defer tags). Per select rule the offered decision is marked diverged=true; client selected the reference-conforming alternative (keep tags). Corrective/select.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker: 'keyword search (title/url/description)'; Round 4 maker: 'Browse, keyword search (title/url/description), tag filter'. Round 4 client: 'This version meets what we agreed on. I'm happy to call it done.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Presented search covers title/url/description but omits the note field, whereas REF-BM-12 requires full-text search over title, description, note, and url. The divergence is established from the presented scope independently; the client approved without expressing the difference. Unexpressed_divergence (approval alone does not establish notice).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Paste an address (optional title/notes), it's validated and saved to your list' (P1). Round 2 client approved revised spec.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Save-by-URL conforms to REF-BM-01; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker P3: 'Fix titles/addresses'; Round 4 maker: 'Edit (title, description, address, notes, tags)'.
decisions.note: Presented edit behaviour conforms to REF-BM-04; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker P3: 'remove items with a confirmation step'; Round 4: 'delete with confirmation'.
decisions.note: Presented delete behaviour conforms to REF-BM-05; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker P2: 'See your list'; Round 4: card-based list with title/tags/favicon displayed.
decisions.note: Presented list display conforms to REF-BM-07; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker P2: 'click to open the page in a new tab'; Round 4: 'open-in-new-tab'.
decisions.note: Presented open-original behaviour conforms to REF-BM-08; recorded conforming decision.
